description: Configure the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server to serve specific file extensions with custom MIME types. You need to ensure that files ending in '.gcode' are served with the Content-Type 'text/x-gcode', and files ending in '.lua' are served with 'text/x-lua'. You can configure this via the Virtualmin web interface under the Services or Server Configuration section for the domain. Make sure to apply your changes so they take effect immediately.
